content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

Not necessarily, Alex. Research shows you can build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets are taken close to failure (about 0 to 3 reps left in the tank). 💪

That said, your goal is a 100 kg bench in three months. Strength is a skill, so you do need to practice heavy, low-rep sets (around 3 to 6 reps) on bench. Keep your accessory work in the 8 to 15 rep range for muscle growth.
